'''Umé''' was a [[human]] who served as one of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens|handmaidens]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]'s [[Royal House of Naboo|Royal House]].<ref name="TVE" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Umé attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of Naboo's [[senator]], [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. The handmaiden took part in Amidala's [[funeral]] procession through<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the [[city]] [[Theed]],<ref name="TVE" /> walking alongside [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Apailana]] of Naboo and another handmaiden. During the event,<ref name="ROTS" /> Umé wore a patterned and hooded [[Color|red]] [[cloak]]. They had light skin and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="TVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umé appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The funeral scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TVE" /> The [[Umé/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by [[Leland Chee]] for the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 142|142nd issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|142|Rogues Gallery (Star Wars Insider)|Rogues Gallery: Loyal to their Queen!}}</ref> published on [[June 10]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=news/get-the-inside-scoop-on-star-wars-insider-142.html|text=Get the Inside Scoop on Star Wars Insider #142}}</ref>
